product.title: Amazon Basics Sturdy and Portable Ergonomic Laptop Stand for Desk, Height Adjustable Riser with Ventilated Cooling, Foldable, Fits all Laptops up to 15.6 Inch, Silver

reviews: Excellent laptop stand! Very sturdy, adjustable, and helps improve posture while working. Sleek design and great value for the price

I picked up this Amazon Basics ergonomic laptop stand to improve my desk setup, and it’s been a solid upgrade. I spend a lot of time on my laptop, so I wanted something that would raise the screen and help with posture. The stand is sturdy and holds the laptop securely, even when typing. It fits larger laptops (up to around 17 inches), which makes it versatile for different devices. What I like most is the adjustable height. It lets you bring the screen closer to eye level, which helps reduce neck strain during longer sessions. Experts often recommend using a stand like this to improve posture when working on a laptop. It’s also lightweight and portable, so it’s easy to move between rooms or take with you if needed. Overall, it’s a simple but effective accessory if you want a more comfortable and ergonomic workspace without spending a lot.

I was going to buy Native Union laptop stand for 3 times the price but they were out of stock in silver that I bought this one due to good reviews. It is easy to set up, sturdy, great grips on the bottom and where the laptop sits, aesthetically looks nice, great value for the price, highly recommend.

I ended up returning this because my laptop bounced as I typed on my desk. I have a smaller adjustable sit/stand desk, so I think the desk itself moves a small amount as a result of typing or bumping it. That caused my laptop to shake while using it. I also didn't like the angle at which my laptop rested, especially when I wasn't using it. Good piece of equipment and it did feel sturdy but just didn't work for my setup.

I got this to make a work setup for my 16" MacBook Pro. The screen on the laptop is big, but when I use it as a desktop it sits too low. I have a second monitor, and with this stand the two sit side-by-side making it much more useful. Clearly, in this setup you need to have a desktop keyboard and mouse, but I do. I have a dock, and all the desktop components, and with this stand I can really feel that the laptop is just another desktop. This makes for working at home much nicer, but still allows me to unplug and take the laptop on the road. Before this I simply used the external monitor, and kept the laptop closed. This is a problem with the fingerprint sensor in the laptop, and wastes the beautiful screen that comes on the MacBook Pro. So, this simple stand enabled me to use the laptop as a second monitor, lifts it up so that it gets better airflow underneath and as a result it keeps it cooler (this is not really a problem on a MacBook anyway, but still nice). With this stand I can't remember a time that the fan actually turned on while I was working. Can anyone with an Intel PC say that, I don't think so. ;). But, this would keep the intel heaters running just a bit cooler as the underside airflow would be unrestricted. A few notes, it is really stiff, this is good because you want it to maintain its position. But, you have to apply some pressure to move it to the setting you want, this is normal. You basically set it and forget it. If you want an easily adjustable stand, this is probably not the right one for you. There is no way to make it easy to adjust. No screw to tighten or loosen for ease of movement. It is just sturdy and stiff at all times. For a set and forget setup it is really perfect, however.
Very sturdy! It’s my first time using a laptop holder, it provides more space on the desk and moves the screen to eye line. The stand is adjustable and holds steady. No regrets.

As a computer science teacher, I often spend a lot of time in front of a laptop. I struggled to find a shelf that provided the right height and depth for my computer. Then I tried this portable stand. It is lightweight, easy to maneuver, great size for smaller desks, and works like a charm. I am able to adjust the height of the base so my screen is eye level and there is no neck straining taking place. In addition, it is sturdy enough to hold my MacBook in place while I constantly type. Great value

This little stand is great. It's various heights are great for different projects, and I even used it on a recent flight to lift my phone higher by sticking it in the top pocket above the tray table so I wasn't craving my neck to watch shows. My two minor complaints are that it is EXTREMELY stiff and difficult to change height, and the second is directly related in that the top plate feels flimsy and feels like it will snap any time I adjust the stand upwards.
